critical_steps: The original family with Lambda=K is Parseval relative to K.
R(U)=R(K) and ||U*f||=||K*f||, so the printed hypotheses hold with delta one.
KU*=0, so the transformed coefficient family is zero.
The disputed Moore-Penrose factor is the orthogonal projection onto R(K) and requires R(U*) subset R(K).
The exact transformed frame operator is U S_Lambda U*.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact two-dimensional one-component K-g-fusion construction and direct frame-operator calculation.
integrity.unproved_limits: No weakest simple range-only hypothesis is claimed beyond the exact operator domination criterion.

scientific_limitations: The finding corrects Theorem 4 only and does not reassess the other construction and duality theorems.
The adjoint-range condition is a sufficient repair for the published proof; the exact necessary-and-sufficient condition is operator domination by the transformed frame operator.
A nonindexed erratum or informal correction may contain the same observation.
title: Adjoint-range failure in a transformed \(K\)-\(g\)-fusion frame theorem
